thesis: Final-answer parity in an answer-held-fixed control does not imply memory-state parity. ADMIT controls the write-time transition through which a public output becomes automatically reusable factual memory; the typed dynamic replay measures a small answer cost for that control.

static.population: M3DocVQA 2,324-query candidate-complete subset: disjoint 1,162-qid calibration and reporting partitions
static.exclusion_scope: inherited candidate-complete harness population; not the full released validation set
static.reader: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for initial read and RepairRead
static.actual_image_input: 2315/2324 initial-read artifacts; 1155/1162 cached candidate RepairRead artifacts
static.definitive_policy: fixed refusal -> typed STATUS without RepairRead; unsupported non-refusal -> at most one RepairRead -> MFC/OFO
static.EM: dynamic-aligned bidirectional lowercase/whitespace-normalized substring EM for every initial and RepairRead output; fixed refusals receive zero

learned_router_diagnostic.model_selection: nested calibration-only folds; final round count is the median selected count
learned_router_diagnostic.threshold: median of calibration baseline-row OOF scores
learned_router_diagnostic.result: no detectable answer-metric gain over deterministic routing; +0.09 pp EM with CI including zero at +0.493 calls/q; descriptive reporting-set diagnostic, not an untouched confirmatory claim

dynamic.router_scope: historical compatibility diagnostic; no causal compute-saving claim; not required for the lexical guarantee
dynamic.factual_consumer_rule: retrieval, planning, and synthesis read FACT projection only
dynamic.status_records: REFUSAL and NO_COMMIT remain in audit state but are excluded from factual prompts
dynamic.utility_state_result: ADMIT vs fail-open: -0.67 pp substring EM (95% CI [-1.33,-0.11]) and -13.67 pp all-write lexical trajectory contamination

rerun_scope.contract: typed FACT/STATUS store; factual consumers read FACT projection only
rerun_scope.selection: union of pairs with an intermediate refusal or NO_COMMIT in any frozen arm

dynamic.contamination_scope: all reuse-eligible content writes, including the terminal memory write
dynamic.final_support_memory_policy: Post-hoc support checking and RepairRead update only the output; all Vanilla memory writes, including the pre-repair terminal write, remain unchanged.

metric_definitions.contamination: all reuse-eligible content writes, including the terminal memory write contains at least one non-refusal value without lexical support in its exact reader-visible OCR/text
metric_definitions.no_commit: trajectory contains at least one NO_COMMIT memory write
metric_definitions.raw_em: normalized bidirectional substring EM in the dynamic runner; fixed refusals and empty outputs score zero
metric_definitions.static_em: bidirectional substring EM after lowercase/whitespace normalization, identical to dynamic raw EM, for every initial and RepairRead output; fixed refusals and empty outputs score zero
metric_definitions.unsupNR_strict: per-query indicator that the output is a non-refusal and its normalized answer is not a substring of the exact reader-visible OCR/text packet; averaged over all queries, not only non-refusals
metric_definitions.value_supported_EM: per-query static EM indicator multiplied by the normalized substring-support indicator; averaged over all queries
metric_definitions.F1: SQuAD-style token F1 after lowercasing, punctuation/article removal, and short-answer extraction; max over gold alternatives
metric_definitions.ANLS: full-string normalized Levenshtein similarity after the same normalization and short-answer extraction; tau=0.5; max over gold alternatives
metric_definitions.calls_q: total reader calls per qid; final-only incremental retry is added to its vanilla base trajectory
